decisions.choice: the word that came to Jeremiah: the heading of a new collection, the promises of restoration in chapters 30-33
decisions.reason: This heading opens messages in 7:1, 11:1 and 21:1. Here it begins a group of chapters (30-33) that are almost all promise: the LORD will bring his people home, heal them and make a new covenant with them. The chapters before it are mostly warnings of judgment.

decisions.choice: The word that came to Jeremiah from the LORD, saying: / This message came to Jeremiah from the LORD: / This is the message the LORD gave Jeremiah:
decisions.reason: The book's fixed wording for this heading (as in 7:1 and 11:1). Balanced makes the heading a sentence and drops "saying", which only introduces what follows, and Readable says it plainly.

decisions.choice: No deity_pronoun spans in Amharic
decisions.reason: The Ethiopic script has no capital letters, so the English setting that capitalizes pronouns for God has nothing to change; this chapter's Amharic has no deity_pronoun spans.

decisions.choice: "Слово, що було до Єремії від ГОСПОДА, кажучи:" (L), "Це послання прийшло до Єремії від ГОСПОДА:" (B), "Ось послання, яке ГОСПОДЬ дав Єремії:" (R) for this heading formula, wherever it returns in chapters 30-52
decisions.reason: One wording per level for the heading formula of the Jeremiah terms note, matching the 1:4 formula's "послання" at Readable. The chapters before 28 were drafted separately; a reviewer should make the two halves agree.

decisions.choice: वचन ... पहुँचा (L, B); संदेश दिया (R)
decisions.reason: The heading of chapters 30-33, "the book of consolation", keeps the formula's wording at each level (as 26:1, 27:1). The Hindi adds no title of its own, as the English adds none.

decisions.choice: Слово, которое было к Иеремии от ГОСПОДА, говоря (L); Вот слово, с которым Это слово пришло к Иеремии от ГОСПОДА (B) (B); которое ГОСПОДЬ дал Иеремии (R)

decisions.choice: book: a written document, in Jeremiah's time a scroll
decisions.reason: The word means any written record: a letter (29:1), a deed (32:10) or a longer work. Books were written on rolls of leather or papyrus, like the scroll Jeremiah dictated to Baruch (36:2).

decisions.choice: all the words I have spoken to you: the messages of hope that follow
decisions.reason: Verse 4 says "these are the words", pointing ahead to the poems of chapters 30-31. Writing them down keeps the promise for the people who will see the "days" of verse 3, after the exile.

decisions.choice: double quotation marks for the LORD's words in this prose introduction
decisions.reason: Verses 1-4 are prose, so the LORD's command and promise (verses 2-3) are quoted as prose quotes speech. The poems that begin at verse 5 follow the book's rule for oracles and take no outer quotation marks.

decisions.choice: on a scroll
decisions.reason: Readable names the kind of book Jeremiah would have written on (m1).

decisions.choice: un rollo
decisions.reason: A written book in Jeremiah's time was a scroll (meaning decision m1); Readable says "rollo", the published word for a scroll (Luke 4:17), as the English Readable does.

decisions.choice: gombo
decisions.reason: A book then was a scroll; Readable says "gombo", the settled word for a scroll (Luke 4:17), as the English Readable says "scroll".

decisions.choice: "sur un rouleau" (R); "dans un livre" (L, B)
alternatives: dans un livre at every level
decisions.reason: As the English: Readable names the kind of book Jeremiah wrote on, using the word the terms note sets for the scroll.

decisions.choice: "cuốn sách" (L, B); "cuộn sách" (R)

decisions.choice: "책" (L, B); "두루마리" (R)

decisions.choice: God's words in double quotation marks in this prose introduction
decisions.reason: As the English: verses 2-3 are prose, and the poems from verse 5 take no marks.

fr.R: Un temps vient, dit {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}, où je rendrai de nouveau heureux {{deity_pronoun:mon|Mon}} peuple, Israël et Juda. Je les ramènerai dans le pays que j’ai donné à leurs {{gender:ancêtres|pères}}, et ce pays sera de nouveau à eux. »

sw.L: Kwa maana tazama, siku zinakuja, asema {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, nitakapowarudishia mafanikio watu {{deity_pronoun:wangu|Wangu}} Israeli na Yuda, asema {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, nami nitawarudisha katika nchi niliyowapa baba zao, nao wataimiliki."
sw.B: Kwa maana siku zinakuja, asema {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, nitakapowarudishia mafanikio watu {{deity_pronoun:wangu|Wangu}} Israeli na Yuda, asema {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}. Nitawarudisha katika nchi niliyowapa babu zao, nao wataimiliki."
sw.R: Wakati unakuja, anasema {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, nitakapoyafanya mambo kuwa mema tena kwa watu {{deity_pronoun:wangu|Wangu}}, Israeli na Yuda. Nitawarudisha katika nchi niliyowapa babu zao, nayo itakuwa yao tena."

vi.L: Vì kìa, những ngày đang đến, {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} phán vậy, khi {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} sẽ phục hồi cơ đồ của dân {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} là Y-sơ-ra-ên và Giu-đa, {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} phán, và {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} sẽ đem họ trở về xứ {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} đã ban cho tổ phụ họ, và họ sẽ chiếm hữu xứ ấy."
vi.B: Vì sẽ đến những ngày, {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} phán vậy, {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} sẽ phục hồi cơ đồ của dân {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} là Y-sơ-ra-ên và Giu-đa, {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} phán. Ta sẽ đem họ trở về xứ {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} đã ban cho tổ tiên họ, và họ sẽ chiếm hữu xứ ấy."

ru.L: Ведь вот, приходят дни, — слово {{divine_name:ГОСПОДА|Яхве}}, — когда {{deity_pronoun:я|Я}} восстановлю благополучие {{deity_pronoun:моего|Моего}} народа Израиля и Иуды, — говорит {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Яхве}}, — и верну их в землю, которую {{deity_pronoun:я|Я}} дал их отцам, и они овладеют ею.»

ja.L: 見なさい、日々が来る――{{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}の言葉――。そのとき、わたしは、わたしの民イスラエルとユダの繁栄を元どおりにする、と{{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}は言う。わたしは彼らを、わたしが彼らの父祖たちに与えた地に帰らせ、彼らはそれを所有する。」
ja.B: その日が来る、と{{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}は告げる。そのとき、わたしは、わたしの民イスラエルとユダの繁栄を回復する、と{{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}は言う。わたしは彼らを、彼らの先祖に与えた地に連れ戻し、彼らはその地を所有する。」
ja.R: その時が来る、と{{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}は言う。そのとき、わたしは、わたしの民イスラエルとユダを、再び幸せにする。わたしは彼らを、彼らの先祖に与えた地に連れ戻す。その地は、再び彼らのものになる。」

uk.L: Бо ось дні приходять, говорить {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Ягве}}, коли {{deity_pronoun:я|Я}} поверну долю {{deity_pronoun:мого|Мого}} народу, Ізраїлю і Юдеї, каже {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Ягве}}, і поверну їх до землі, яку {{deity_pronoun:я|Я}} дав їхнім батькам, і вони заволодіють нею».

decisions.choice: restore the fortunes: turn the people's ruin into well-being, including bringing the exiles home
decisions.reason: The phrase repeats one root, "turn the turning". It means a complete reversal from ruin to blessing; it is used of Job, who was never a captive (Job 42:10), and of the land and people as a whole (Deuteronomy 30:3; Psalm 126:4). Because the noun sounds like the word for captivity, it was long read "bring back the captivity", and here the return from exile is part of what is meant, as the rest of the verse says. Jeremiah uses the phrase in 29:14 and through the promises of chapters 30-33 (30:18; 31:23; 32:44; 33:7, 11, 26).

decisions.choice: Israel and Judah: the whole people, both the northern kingdom and the southern
decisions.reason: The northern kingdom, Israel, had been taken into exile by Assyria a century earlier (2 Kings 17:6), and Judah was going into exile in Babylon. The promise covers both, as do 3:18 and 31:27, 31.

decisions.choice: the land I gave their fathers, and they will possess it: the gift of the land made new
decisions.reason: The words recall the promise to Abraham, Isaac and Jacob and the call to "possess" the land in Deuteronomy (Deuteronomy 1:8; 30:5). Exile seemed to undo that gift; here it is given again.

decisions.choice: restore the fortunes (L, B); make things good again for (R)
decisions.reason: One wording for this phrase wherever it returns in Jeremiah, as in Deuteronomy 30:3. Readable says what the phrase means (m1).

decisions.choice: the second "says the LORD" left out
decisions.reason: The verse names the LORD as speaker twice. Readable gives the formula once, at the start, to keep the sentence short; the meaning is unchanged.

decisions.choice: dice el SEÑOR
decisions.reason: The Hebrew here has the plain verb "says" (*amar*) beside *neʾum YHWH*, so Literal and Balanced keep "dice" for it, distinct from "declara" / "afirma"; Readable leaves it out, as the English does.

decisions.choice: "phục hồi cơ đồ" (L, B); "làm cho mọi sự tốt đẹp trở lại" (R)
decisions.reason: The wording settled for shuv shevut at 29:14, used here and in the rest of chapters 30-33.

decisions.choice: "운명을 돌이키다" (L); "형편을 회복시키다" (B); "다시 잘되게 해 주다" (R) for *shuv shevut*
decisions.reason: The wording set at 29:14 for "restore the fortunes", which here includes bringing the exiles home (meaning decision m1).

decisions.choice: restaurar a sorte (L, B); fazer a vida ... voltar a ser boa (R)
decisions.reason: For the whole book, as 29:14 first has it (r-pt-1 there), where the English keeps one wording for the phrase (m1; also verse 18; 31:23; 32:44; 33:7, 11, 26): the wording of Deuteronomy 30:3 in Portuguese at each level, "restaurar a sorte", and at Readable that verse's "fazer a vida voltar a ser boa".

decisions.choice: "እነሆ፣ ቀኖች ይመጣሉ፤ ይላል እግዚአብሔር፤ [በዚያን ጊዜ] …" (Literal); "ቀኖች ይመጣሉ …" (Balanced); "ጊዜ ይመጣል …" (Readable); restore the fortunes "ዕድል ፈንታ መለሰ"
decisions.reason: The book's wording for "days are coming" (as 16:14; 23:5, 7) and for restoring the fortunes (as 29:14).

decisions.choice: {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} कहते हैं for the second formula (amar YHWH)
decisions.reason: The verse has both neʾum YHWH ("declares") and ʾamar YHWH ("says"); Literal and Balanced keep them apart, की यह वाणी है for the first and कहते हैं for the second, as the English does. "Days are coming" keeps the wording of Hebrews 8:8 (ऐसे दिन आ रहे हैं), used again at 31:27, 31, 38.

decisions.choice: восстановлю благополучие (L, B); снова сделаю жизнь хорошей (R)
decisions.reason: "Restore the fortunes" keeps one wording through the book, as in 29:14 and Deuteronomy 30:3.

decisions.choice: — слово ГОСПОДА (neʾum); — говорит ГОСПОДЬ (ʾamar)
decisions.reason: The verse has two different verbs for the LORD's speaking: neʾum takes the set "слово ГОСПОДА" at Literal, and the second, a plain "says", is "говорит ГОСПОДЬ", as the English says "declares ... says".

decisions.choice: hinneh yamim ba'im "見なさい、日々が来る" (L), "その日が来る" (B), "その時が来る" (R), the JER-2 forms; shavti 'et shevut "繁栄を元どおりにする" (L), "繁栄を回復する" (B), "再び幸せにする" (R), as 29:14 (m1); 'amar YHWH "と{D}は言う" (L, B), left out at R as the English R.
decisions.reason: JER-2 formulas; JER-5 shuv shevut (29:14).

records.literal_gloss: For thus says Yahweh: [A] sound of trembling we have heard, dread, and there is not peace.

en.L: For thus says {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}: \q "A sound of trembling we have heard, \q terror, and there is no peace."
en.B: For {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} says this: \q "We have heard a cry of panic, \q of terror, and there is no peace."
en.R: This is what {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} says: \q "We hear people screaming in fear. \q Everyone is terrified, and there is no peace."

es.L: Porque así dice {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}}: \q «Hemos oído un clamor de espanto, \q de terror, y no hay paz».
es.B: Porque {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} dice esto: \q «Hemos oído un grito de pánico, \q de terror, y no hay paz».
es.R: Esto es lo que dice {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}}: \q «Oímos a la gente gritar de miedo. \q Todos están aterrados, y no hay paz».

fr.L: Car ainsi parle {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} : \q « Nous avons entendu un bruit d’épouvante, \q de terreur, et il n’y a pas de paix. »
fr.B: Car {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} dit ceci : \q « Nous avons entendu un cri de panique, \q de terreur, et il n’y a pas de paix. »
fr.R: Voici ce que dit {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} : \q « Nous entendons des gens crier de peur. \q Tout le monde est terrifié, et il n’y a pas de paix. »

sw.L: Kwa maana {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} asema hivi: \q "Tumesikia sauti ya kutetemeka, \q hofu, wala hakuna amani."
sw.B: Kwa maana hivi ndivyo {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} asemavyo: \q "Tumesikia kilio cha woga, \q cha hofu kuu, wala hakuna amani."
sw.R: Hili ndilo {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} analosema: \q "Tunasikia watu wakipiga kelele kwa woga. \q Kila mtu ameingiwa na hofu, wala hakuna amani."

vi.L: Vì {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} phán thế này: \q "Chúng ta đã nghe tiếng run rẩy, \q tiếng kinh hãi, chẳng có bình an."
vi.B: Vì {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} phán như vầy: \q "Chúng ta đã nghe tiếng kêu la hoảng loạn, \q tiếng kinh hoàng, chẳng còn bình an."
vi.R: Đây là lời {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} phán: \q "Chúng ta nghe tiếng người ta kêu la sợ hãi. \q Ai cũng kinh hoàng, và chẳng có bình an."

ko.L: {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 이와 같이 말씀하신다. \q "우리가 떨리는 소리를 들었다. \q 공포뿐이고 평안이 없다."
ko.B: {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 이렇게 말씀하신다. \q "우리가 겁에 질린 비명 소리를 들었다. \q 공포뿐이고 평안이 없다."
ko.R: {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 하시는 말씀이다. \q "사람들이 무서워 비명을 지르는 소리가 들린다. \q 모두가 겁에 질려 있고, 평안이 없다."

pt.L: Pois assim diz {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}}: \q "Um som de tremor ouvimos, \q terror, e não há paz."
pt.B: Pois assim diz {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}}: \q "Ouvimos um grito de pânico, \q de terror, e não há paz."
pt.R: É isto que {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}} diz: \q "Ouvimos pessoas gritando de medo. \q Todos estão apavorados, e não há paz."

am.L: {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}} እንዲህ ይላልና፦ \q «የመንቀጥቀጥ ድምፅ ሰምተናል፤ \q ፍርሃት ነው፤ ሰላምም የለም።»
am.B: {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}} እንዲህ ይላልና፦ \q «የሽብር ጩኸት ሰምተናል፤ \q የፍርሃት ጩኸት ነው፤ ሰላምም የለም።»
am.R: {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}} እንዲህ ይላል፦ \q «ሰዎች በፍርሃት ሲጮኹ እንሰማለን። \q ሁሉም ደንግጧል፤ ሰላምም የለም።»

hi.L: क्योंकि {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} यों कहते हैं: \q "थरथराहट का शब्द हमने सुना है, \q भय, और शान्ति नहीं है।"
hi.B: क्योंकि {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} यह कहते हैं: \q "हमने घबराहट की चीख़ सुनी है, \q आतंक की, और कहीं शान्ति नहीं।"
hi.R: {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} यह कहते हैं: \q "हम लोगों को डर के मारे चीख़ते सुनते हैं। \q हर कोई भयभीत है, और कहीं शान्ति नहीं।"

ru.L: Ведь так говорит {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Яхве}}: \q «Звук трепета мы услышали, \q ужас, и нет мира.»
ru.B: Ведь так говорит {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Яхве}}: \q «Мы слышим крик паники, \q крик ужаса, и нет мира.»
ru.R: Вот что говорит {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Яхве}}: \q «Мы слышим, как люди кричат от страха. \q Все в ужасе, и нет мира.»

ja.L: まことに、{{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}はこう言われる。 \q 「わたしたちはおののきの声を聞いた。 \q 恐れであって、平和はない。」
ja.B: {{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}はこう言われる。 \q 「わたしたちは、恐怖の叫びを聞いた。 \q 恐れがあり、平和はない。」
ja.R: {{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}はこう言われる。 \q 「人々が恐ろしさに叫んでいるのが聞こえる。 \q だれもがおびえていて、平和はない。」

uk.L: Бо так говорить {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Ягве}}: \q «Голос тремтіння ми почули, \q жах, і немає миру».
uk.B: Бо так говорить {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Ягве}}: \q «Ми почули крик тривоги, \q жаху, і немає миру».
uk.R: Так говорить {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Ягве}}: \q «Ми чуємо, як люди кричать від страху. \q Усі нажахані, і немає миру».

decisions.choice: we have heard: the voice of the frightened people, quoted by the LORD
decisions.reason: The poem opens in the middle of panic. The LORD quotes those who hear the sounds of war: the people, or the prophet speaking with them (compare 4:19-21; 8:15). The promise comes only after the terror has been heard (verse 7).

decisions.choice: a sound of trembling, dread: the noise and the feeling of panic
decisions.reason: The first word can mean a voice or a sound, here the cries and noise of people shaking with fear. The second is sudden dread (49:5; Isaiah 24:17).

decisions.choice: there is no peace: no safety or well-being
decisions.reason: The words answer the false prophets, who said "Peace, peace" when there was no peace (6:14; 8:11, 15). Peace here is the whole well-being of the people.

decisions.choice: double quotation marks around the people's cry
decisions.reason: Under the book's speech rule the LORD's own words in the oracle take no quotation marks, but speech he quotes inside it does (m1).

decisions.choice: people screaming ... Everyone is terrified
decisions.reason: Readable names who is making the sound and who is afraid, which the Hebrew leaves to the picture.

decisions.choice: quotation marks for the people's cry
decisions.reason: The cry is the people's, quoted inside the LORD's oracle, so it takes quotation marks as in the English; the oracle itself takes none.

decisions.choice: "chúng ta" (we) in the people's cry
decisions.reason: The frightened people speak among themselves, so Vietnamese uses the inclusive "chúng ta".

decisions.choice: The people's cry in double quotation marks inside the oracle
decisions.reason: The LORD quotes the frightened people (meaning decision m1); as the terms note, speech quoted inside an oracle takes quotation marks, while God's own words do not.

decisions.reason: JER-1 shalom; the English marks the cry as a quotation.

records.literal_gloss: Ask please and see whether giving birth [is a] male; why have I seen every man, his hands on his loins, like [one] giving birth, and turned all faces to paleness?

en.L: Ask now and see \q whether a male gives birth. \q Why then do I see every man with his hands on his loins like a woman giving birth, \q and every face turned pale?
en.B: Ask and see: \q can a man give birth? \q Then why do I see every man with his hands pressed to his sides like a woman in labor, \q every face gone deathly pale?
en.R: Ask around and find out: \q Can a man have a baby? \q Then why do I see every man holding his sides in pain like a woman giving birth? \q Why has every face turned pale?

es.L: {{plural_you:Pregunten|Preguntad}} ahora y {{plural_you:vean|ved}} \q si un varón da a luz. \q ¿Por qué, pues, veo a todo hombre con las manos sobre sus lomos como mujer que da a luz, \q y se han vuelto pálidos todos los rostros?
es.B: {{plural_you:Pregunten|Preguntad}} y {{plural_you:vean|ved}}: \q ¿puede un hombre dar a luz? \q Entonces, ¿por qué veo a todos los hombres con las manos apretadas a la cintura como mujer de parto, \q con el rostro pálido como la muerte?
es.R: {{plural_you:Pregunten|Preguntad}} por ahí y {{plural_you:averigüen|averiguad}}: \q ¿Puede un hombre tener un bebé? \q Entonces, ¿por qué veo a todos los hombres sujetándose la cintura de dolor, como una mujer que está dando a luz? \q ¿Por qué todas las caras se han puesto pálidas?

fr.L: Demandez donc et voyez \q si un mâle enfante. \q Pourquoi donc vois-je tout homme les mains sur les reins comme une femme qui enfante, \q et tous les visages devenus livides ?
fr.B: Demandez et voyez : \q un homme peut-il enfanter ? \q Alors pourquoi vois-je tous les hommes les mains pressées sur les flancs, comme une femme en travail, \q et tous les visages devenus blêmes ?
fr.R: Renseignez-vous et cherchez : \q un homme peut-il avoir un bébé ? \q Alors pourquoi est-ce que je vois tous les hommes se tenir les côtés de douleur, comme une femme qui accouche ? \q Pourquoi tous les visages sont-ils devenus pâles ?

sw.L: Ulizeni sasa mkaone \q kama mwanamume huzaa. \q Mbona basi namwona kila mwanamume ameweka mikono yake viunoni kama mwanamke anayezaa, \q na nyuso zote zimegeuka kuwa za rangi ya kifo?
sw.B: Ulizeni mkaone: \q je, mwanamume anaweza kuzaa? \q Mbona basi namwona kila mwanamume amebana mikono viunoni mwake kama mwanamke mwenye utungu, \q na kila uso umegeuka rangi kama wa maiti?
sw.R: Ulizeni kila mahali mkajue: \q Je, mwanamume anaweza kuzaa mtoto? \q Mbona basi namwona kila mwanamume ameshika kiuno chake kwa maumivu kama mwanamke anayezaa? \q Mbona kila uso umegeuka rangi?

vi.L: Hãy hỏi xem \q đàn ông có sinh con được chăng? \q Sao {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} thấy mọi người nam đều đặt tay trên hông như đàn bà sinh nở, \q và mọi khuôn mặt đều tái nhợt?
vi.B: Hãy hỏi mà xem: \q đàn ông có thể sinh con sao? \q Thế sao {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} thấy mọi người nam đều ôm chặt hai bên hông như đàn bà chuyển dạ, \q mọi khuôn mặt đều tái mét?
vi.R: Hãy đi hỏi cho biết: \q Đàn ông có thể sinh con không? \q Thế sao {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} thấy mọi người đàn ông đều ôm hông vì đau như người đàn bà sinh con? \q Sao mặt mọi người đều tái nhợt?

ko.L: 물어보고 살펴보아라. \q 남자가 아이를 낳느냐? \q 그런데 어찌하여 내가 보니 모든 남자가 해산하는 여자처럼 손을 허리에 대고 있으며, \q 모든 얼굴이 창백하게 변했느냐?
ko.B: 물어보고 살펴보아라. \q 남자가 아이를 낳을 수 있느냐? \q 그런데 어찌하여 모든 남자가 진통하는 여자처럼 두 손으로 허리를 움켜쥐고 있으며, \q 모든 얼굴이 죽은 사람처럼 창백해졌느냐?
ko.R: 여기저기 물어서 알아보아라. \q 남자가 아기를 낳을 수 있느냐? \q 그런데 어찌하여 모든 남자가 아이를 낳는 여자처럼 아파서 옆구리를 움켜쥐고 있느냐? \q 어찌하여 모든 얼굴이 창백해졌느냐?

pt.L: Perguntem agora e vejam \q se um homem dá à luz. \q Por que então vejo todo homem com as mãos sobre os lombos, como a que dá à luz, \q e todos os rostos se tornaram pálidos?
pt.B: Perguntem e vejam: \q pode um homem dar à luz? \q Então por que vejo todo homem com as mãos apertando os lados do corpo, como uma mulher em trabalho de parto, \q e todos os rostos pálidos como a morte?
pt.R: Perguntem por aí e descubram: \q Pode um homem ter um bebê? \q Então por que vejo todo homem segurando os lados do corpo de dor, como uma mulher dando à luz? \q Por que todos os rostos ficaram pálidos?

am.L: እስኪ ጠይቁ፤ እዩም፤ \q ወንድ ይወልድ እንደ ሆነ። \q ታዲያ ሰውን ሁሉ እንደምትወልድ ሴት እጆቹን በወገቡ ላይ አድርጎ ለምን አያለሁ? \q ፊትስ ሁሉ ለምን ገረጣ?
am.B: ጠይቁና እዩ፤ \q ወንድ ሊወልድ ይችላልን? \q ታዲያ ወንድ ሁሉ እንደምታምጥ ሴት እጆቹን በጎኑ ላይ ጭኖ ለምን አያለሁ? \q ፊት ሁሉ ለምን እንደ ሞተ ሰው ገረጣ?
am.R: ዞር ብላችሁ ጠይቁ፤ እወቁም፤ \q ወንድ ልጅ ሊወልድ ይችላልን? \q ታዲያ ወንድ ሁሉ እንደምትወልድ ሴት በሕመም ጎኑን ይዞ ለምን አያለሁ? \q ፊት ሁሉ ለምን ገረጣ?

hi.L: अब पूछो और देखो \q कि क्या कोई पुरुष जनता है। \q तो फिर मैं हर पुरुष को जनती हुई स्त्री के समान अपनी कमर पर हाथ रखे हुए क्यों देखता हूँ, \q और हर चेहरा पीला क्यों पड़ गया है?
hi.B: पूछो और देखो: \q क्या कोई पुरुष बच्चा जन सकता है? \q तो फिर मैं हर पुरुष को प्रसव-पीड़ा में पड़ी स्त्री की तरह अपनी कमर को हाथों से दबाए हुए क्यों देखता हूँ, \q हर चेहरा मुर्दे जैसा पीला क्यों पड़ गया है?
hi.R: इधर-उधर पूछो और पता लगाओ: \q क्या कोई आदमी बच्चे को जन्म दे सकता है? \q तो फिर मैं हर आदमी को बच्चा जनती स्त्री की तरह दर्द से अपनी कमर पकड़े हुए क्यों देखता हूँ? \q हर चेहरा पीला क्यों पड़ गया है?

ru.L: Спросите же и посмотрите, \q рождает ли мужчина? \q Почему же {{deity_pronoun:я|Я}} вижу всякого мужчину с руками на бёдрах, как у роженицы, \q и все лица побледнели?
ru.B: Спросите и посмотрите: \q может ли мужчина родить? \q Почему же {{deity_pronoun:я|Я}} вижу каждого мужчину с руками, прижатыми к бокам, как у женщины в родах, \q и каждое лицо смертельно бледно?
ru.R: Спросите и узнайте: \q может ли мужчина родить ребёнка? \q Почему же {{deity_pronoun:я|Я}} вижу, что каждый мужчина держится за бока от боли, как женщина в родах? \q Почему все лица побледнели?

ja.L: さあ、尋ねて、見よ。 \q 男が子を産むことがあるかどうかを。 \q なぜ、わたしは、すべての男が、子を産む女のように両手を腰に当てているのを見るのか。 \q また、すべての顔が青ざめてしまったのを。
ja.B: 尋ねて、確かめてみなさい。 \q 男が子を産むことがあるだろうか。 \q それなのに、なぜ、どの男も、産みの苦しみの女のように、両手で脇腹を押さえているのか。 \q どの顔も、死人のように青ざめているのか。
ja.R: 周りの人に聞いて、確かめてみなさい。 \q 男の人が、赤ちゃんを産むことがあるだろうか？ \q それなのに、なぜ、どの男も、子を産む女のように、痛そうに脇腹を押さえているのか？ \q なぜ、どの顔も青ざめているのか？

uk.L: Спитайте ж і подивіться, \q чи народжує чоловік. \q Чому ж {{deity_pronoun:я|Я}} бачу кожного мужа з руками на стегнах, як у породіллі, \q і всяке обличчя пожовкло?
uk.B: Спитайте й подивіться: \q хіба чоловік може народити? \q Чому ж тоді {{deity_pronoun:я|Я}} бачу кожного чоловіка з руками, притиснутими до боків, як у жінки при пологах, \q і кожне обличчя смертельно зблідло?
uk.R: Розпитайте й дізнайтеся: \q хіба чоловік може народити дитину? \q Чому ж тоді {{deity_pronoun:я|Я}} бачу, що кожен чоловік тримається за боки від болю, як жінка, що народжує? \q Чому кожне обличчя зблідло?

decisions.choice: can a male give birth? like a woman in labor: men gripped by pain and terror they cannot escape
decisions.reason: Labor pains are the prophets' picture for sudden, overwhelming terror (4:31; 6:24; 13:21; 22:23; Isaiah 13:8). The question is meant to sound absurd: men cannot give birth, yet every man is clutching himself like a woman in labor.

decisions.choice: man: a grown man, one expected to be strong
decisions.reason: This word for man often stresses strength (Psalm 34:9; Jeremiah 17:5). That the strong are bent double makes the picture sharper.

decisions.choice: paleness: the gray or sickly color of a face drained of blood
decisions.reason: The word is used of crops struck by blight (Deuteronomy 28:22; Amos 4:9). Here it is the color of faces white with fear (compare Joel 2:6).

decisions.choice: hands pressed to his sides (B); holding his sides in pain (R)
decisions.reason: Literal keeps "loins", the waist and lower back, where a woman in labor holds herself. Balanced and Readable say "sides" for a modern reader, and Readable adds "in pain", which the comparison implies.

decisions.choice: gever "男" (a grown man expected to be strong, m2); yadav 'al chalatsav kayyoledah "子を産む女のように両手を腰に当てて" (L), "産みの苦しみの女のように、両手で脇腹を押さえて" (B), R "痛そうに脇腹を押さえて" (m1); yeraqon "青ざめる" (m3).
decisions.reason: As the English levels; commands in the oracle forms (尋ねて、見よ L; 確かめてみなさい B, R).

source.text: ה֗וֹי כִּ֥י גָד֛וֹל הַיּ֥וֹם הַה֖וּא מֵאַ֣יִן כָּמֹ֑הוּ וְעֵֽת־צָרָ֥ה הִיא֙ לְיַֽעֲקֹ֔ב וּמִמֶּ֖נָּה יִוָּשֵֽׁעַ׃

records.literal_gloss: Woe! For great [is] the day the that, from there is not like it; and [a] time of distress it [is] for Jacob, and from it he will be saved.

en.L: Woe! For great [is] that day, with none like it; \q it [is] a time of distress for Jacob, \q yet out of it he will be saved.
en.B: Woe! That day is great; there is no other like it. \q It is a time of distress for Jacob, \q yet he will be saved out of it.
en.R: How terrible that day will be! There will be no other day like it. \q It will be a time of great trouble for the people of Jacob, \q but they will be saved from it.

es.L: ¡Ay! Porque grande [es] aquel día, sin otro semejante; \q tiempo de angustia [es] para Jacob, \q pero de él será librado.
es.B: ¡Ay! Aquel día es grande; no hay otro como él. \q Es un tiempo de angustia para Jacob, \q pero será librado de él.
es.R: ¡Qué terrible será aquel día! No habrá otro día como él. \q Será un tiempo de gran angustia para el pueblo de Jacob, \q pero serán librados de él.

fr.L: Malheur ! Car il est grand, ce jour-là, il n’y en a pas de semblable ; \q c’est un temps de détresse pour Jacob, \q mais il en sera sauvé.
fr.B: Malheur ! Ce jour est grand ; il n’y en a pas d’autre pareil. \q C’est un temps de détresse pour Jacob, \q mais il en sera sauvé.
fr.R: Quel malheur ce jour-là ! Il n’y aura pas d’autre jour comme celui-là. \q Ce sera un temps de grande détresse pour le peuple de Jacob, \q mais il en sera sauvé.

sw.L: Ole! Kwa maana siku ile [ni] kuu, hakuna nyingine kama hiyo; \q [ni] wakati wa dhiki kwa Yakobo, \q lakini ataokolewa kutoka katika hiyo.
sw.B: Ole! Siku ile ni kuu; hakuna nyingine kama hiyo. \q Ni wakati wa dhiki kwa Yakobo, \q lakini ataokolewa kutoka katika hiyo.
sw.R: Siku ile itakuwa ya kutisha sana! Hakutakuwa na siku nyingine kama hiyo. \q Itakuwa wakati wa taabu kubwa kwa watu wa Yakobo, \q lakini wataokolewa kutoka katika hiyo.

vi.L: Khốn thay! Vì ngày ấy lớn lắm, chẳng có ngày nào giống như vậy; \q ấy [là] thời kỳ hoạn nạn cho Gia-cốp, \q nhưng nó sẽ được cứu ra khỏi đó.
vi.B: Khốn thay! Ngày ấy thật lớn lao, không ngày nào giống như vậy. \q Ấy là thời kỳ hoạn nạn cho Gia-cốp, \q nhưng nó sẽ được cứu ra khỏi đó.
vi.R: Ngày ấy sẽ khủng khiếp biết bao! Sẽ không có ngày nào giống như vậy. \q Đó sẽ là thời kỳ hoạn nạn lớn cho dân Gia-cốp, \q nhưng họ sẽ được cứu khỏi ngày ấy.

ko.L: 아! 그날은 크도다. 그와 같은 날이 없다. \q 그것은 야곱에게 환난의 때이다. \q 그러나 그는 거기에서 구원을 받을 것이다.
ko.B: 아! 그날은 엄청난 날이다. 그와 같은 날은 다시 없다. \q 그것은 야곱이 고난을 당하는 때이다. \q 그러나 그는 거기에서 구원을 받을 것이다.
ko.R: 그날은 얼마나 끔찍할까! 그런 날은 다시 없을 것이다. \q 야곱의 자손에게 큰 고난이 닥칠 때이다. \q 그러나 그들은 그 고난에서 구원을 받을 것이다.

pt.L: Ai! Pois grande [é] aquele dia, sem outro como ele; \q é tempo de angústia para Jacó, \q mas dele ele será salvo.
pt.B: Ai! Aquele dia é grande; não há outro como ele. \q É um tempo de angústia para Jacó, \q mas ele será salvo dele.
pt.R: Como vai ser terrível aquele dia! Não vai haver outro dia como ele. \q Vai ser um tempo de grande aflição para o povo de Jacó, \q mas eles vão ser salvos dela.

am.L: ወዮ! ያ ቀን ታላቅ ነውና፤ እንደ እርሱ ያለ የለም፤ \q ለያዕቆብ የመከራ ጊዜ ነው፤ \q ከእርሱ ግን ይድናል።
am.B: ወዮ! ያ ቀን ታላቅ ነው፤ እንደ እርሱ ያለ ሌላ የለም። \q ለያዕቆብ የመከራ ጊዜ ነው፤ \q ነገር ግን ከእርሱ ይድናል።
am.R: ያ ቀን እንዴት አስፈሪ ይሆናል! እንደ እርሱ ያለ ሌላ ቀን አይኖርም። \q ለያዕቆብ ሕዝብ የታላቅ መከራ ጊዜ ይሆናል፤ \q ነገር ግን ከእርሱ ይድናሉ።

hi.L: हाय! क्योंकि वह दिन बड़ा [है], उसके समान कोई नहीं; \q वह याकूब के लिए संकट का समय [है], \q फिर भी वह उसमें से बचाया जाएगा।
hi.B: हाय! वह दिन बड़ा है; उसके समान और कोई दिन नहीं। \q वह याकूब के लिए संकट का समय है, \q फिर भी वह उसमें से बचाया जाएगा।
hi.R: वह दिन कितना भयानक होगा! उसके जैसा और कोई दिन नहीं होगा। \q वह याकूब के लोगों के लिए बड़े संकट का समय होगा, \q पर वे उससे बचा लिए जाएँगे।

ru.L: Горе! Ведь велик тот день, нет подобного ему; \q и время бедствия это для Иакова, \q но из него он будет спасён.
ru.B: Горе! Велик тот день, нет другого, подобного ему. \q Это время бедствия для Иакова, \q но он будет спасён из него.
ru.R: Как страшен будет тот день! Не будет другого такого дня. \q Это будет время большой беды для народа Иакова, \q но они будут спасены от неё.

ja.L: ああ、その日は大いなる日、それに並ぶものはない。 \q それはヤコブにとって苦難の時である。 \q しかし、彼はそこから救われる。
ja.B: ああ、その日は大いなる日、これに並ぶ日はない。 \q それはヤコブにとって苦難の時だ。 \q しかし、ヤコブはそこから救われる。
ja.R: ああ、その日は、なんと恐ろしい日になることか！あのような日は、ほかにない。 \q それは、ヤコブの民にとって、ひどい苦しみの時になる。 \q しかし、彼らはそこから救われる。

uk.L: Горе! Бо великий той день, немає подібного до нього; \q час утиску він для Якова, \q але з нього він буде спасенний.
uk.B: Горе! Великий той день, немає іншого такого. \q Це час утиску для Якова, \q але він буде врятований з нього.
uk.R: Який страшний буде той день! Не буде іншого такого дня. \q Це буде час великої біди для нащадків Якова, \q але вони будуть врятовані з неї.

decisions.choice: woe: a cry of alarm and grief, here addressed to no one
decisions.reason: The same cry begins laments for the dead (22:18) and warnings of judgment (Isaiah 5:8). Here it names no one; it is a cry at the sight of the coming day.

decisions.choice: that day is great, with none like it: the day of the LORD's judgment
decisions.reason: "That day" is the day of the LORD, when he acts in judgment (Joel 2:2, 11; Amos 5:18-20; Zephaniah 1:14-15). Daniel 12:1 speaks in similar words of "a time of distress such as has never been".

decisions.choice: a time of distress for Jacob, yet out of it he will be saved: judgment and rescue in the same day
decisions.reason: The day falls on Jacob too, but it does not end him: he will be saved out of it. The verse turns the poem from terror to promise, which verses 8-11 then spell out.

decisions.choice: Jacob: the whole people descended from Jacob
decisions.reason: As often in the prophets, the ancestor's name stands for the nation (verse 10; Isaiah 41:8).

decisions.choice: How terrible that day will be! ... the people of Jacob ... they
decisions.reason: Readable gives the cry its meaning, as the book does for this word, and says "the people of Jacob", as Isaiah's Readable does, so the plural "they" follows (m4).

decisions.choice: Ole! (Literal, Balanced); Itakuwa ya kutisha sana! (Readable)
decisions.reason: *Hoy* here is a cry of alarm with no one named, so Literal and Balanced use the bare "Ole!", and Readable says how terrible the day will be, as the English Readable does.

decisions.choice: "Khốn thay!"
decisions.reason: Here "hoy" is a cry of alarm with no one named after it (meaning decision m1), so Vietnamese uses the bare exclamation "Khốn thay!" rather than the threat form "Khốn cho ...".

decisions.choice: "아!" (L, B); "얼마나 끔찍할까!" (R) for *hoy*
decisions.reason: Here the cry is addressed to no one (meaning decision m1), so it is not the threat "~에게 화가 있다" but a cry of alarm, as the English "Woe!" stands alone.

decisions.choice: "크도다"
decisions.reason: A bare exclamation; Literal keeps a short exclamatory form for the Hebrew's "great!", which Balanced and Readable spell out.

decisions.choice: हाय (L, B); R gives the cry's meaning
decisions.reason: hoy is हाय at Literal and Balanced, as the terms note sets it for the Prophets; Readable says what the cry means, as the English Readable does.

decisions.choice: Горе! (L, B); Как страшен будет тот день! (R)
decisions.reason: The cry hoy takes the prophets note's "Горе" at Literal and Balanced; at Readable it follows the English, which here gives the cry's meaning, since it is addressed to no one.

decisions.choice: hoy "ああ、" (L, B), R "ああ、……なんと恐ろしい日になることか！" as the English R (m1); 'et tsarah "苦難の時" (L, B), "ひどい苦しみの時" (R); Ya'aqov "ヤコブ" (L, B), "ヤコブの民" (R) (m4); yivvashea' "救われる" (m3).
decisions.reason: ISA-1 hoy (alone); yeshu'ah words 救う.

source.text: וְהָיָה֩ בַיּ֨וֹם הַה֜וּא נְאֻ֣ם׀יְהוָ֣ה צְבָא֗וֹת אֶשְׁבֹּ֤ר עֻלּוֹ֙ מֵעַ֣ל צַוָּארֶ֔ךָ וּמוֹסְרוֹתֶ֖יךָ אֲנַתֵּ֑ק וְלֹא־יַעַבְדוּ־ב֥וֹ ע֖וֹד זָרִֽים׃

records.literal_gloss: And it will be on the day the that, declares Yahweh of hosts, I will break his yoke from on your neck, and your bonds I will tear off, and not will make serve him again strangers.

en.L: And it will be on that day, declares {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} of hosts, \q [that] I will break his yoke from off your neck, and your bonds I will tear off, \q and strangers will no longer make him serve [them].
en.B: On that day, declares {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} of Armies, \q I will break his yoke from your neck and tear off your bonds, \q and foreigners will no longer make him serve them.
en.R: On that day, says {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} of Armies, \q I will break the yoke that is on your neck and tear off your chains. \q Foreigners will never again force {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} people to serve them.

es.L: Y sucederá en aquel día, declara {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} de los ejércitos, \q [que] quebraré su yugo de sobre tu cuello, y romperé tus ataduras, \q y extranjeros no lo harán más su siervo.
es.B: Aquel día, afirma {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} de los Ejércitos, \q romperé su yugo de tu cuello y arrancaré tus ataduras, \q y los extranjeros ya no lo harán servirles.
es.R: Ese día, dice {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} de los Ejércitos, \q romperé el yugo que llevas en el cuello y arrancaré tus cadenas. \q Los extranjeros nunca más obligarán a {{deity_pronoun:mi|Mi}} pueblo a servirles.

fr.L: Et il arrivera en ce jour-là, déclare {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} des armées, \q [que] je briserai son joug de dessus ton cou, et je romprai tes liens, \q et des étrangers ne l’asserviront plus.
fr.B: Ce jour-là, déclare {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} des armées, \q je briserai son joug qui pèse sur ton cou et je romprai tes liens, \q et des étrangers ne l’asserviront plus.
fr.R: Ce jour-là, dit {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} des armées, \q je briserai le joug qui est sur ton cou et j’arracherai tes chaînes. \q Plus jamais des étrangers n’obligeront {{deity_pronoun:mon|Mon}} peuple à les servir.

sw.L: Na itakuwa katika siku ile, asema {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} wa majeshi, \q nitaivunja nira yake kutoka shingoni mwako, na vifungo vyako nitavikata, \q wala wageni hawatamtumikisha tena.
sw.B: Siku hiyo, asema {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} wa majeshi, \q nitaivunja nira yake kutoka shingoni mwako na kuvikata vifungo vyako, \q wala wageni hawatamfanya tena awatumikie.
sw.R: Wakati huo, anasema {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} wa majeshi, \q nitaivunja nira iliyo shingoni mwako na kuikata minyororo yako. \q Wageni hawatawalazimisha tena watu {{deity_pronoun:wangu|Wangu}} kuwatumikia.

vi.L: Trong ngày ấy, {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} Vạn Quân phán vậy, \q Ta sẽ bẻ gãy ách của nó khỏi cổ ngươi, {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} sẽ bứt đứt dây trói ngươi, \q và người ngoại sẽ không còn bắt nó phục dịch [chúng] nữa.
vi.B: Trong ngày ấy, {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} Vạn Quân phán vậy, \q Ta sẽ bẻ gãy ách của nó khỏi cổ con và bứt đứt dây trói con, \q và người ngoại quốc sẽ không còn bắt nó phục dịch chúng nữa.
vi.R: Vào ngày ấy, {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} Vạn Quân phán, \q Ta sẽ bẻ gãy cái ách đang đè trên cổ con và bứt đứt xiềng xích con. \q Người ngoại quốc sẽ không bao giờ bắt dân {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} phục dịch chúng nữa.

ko.L: 그날에, 만군의 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}의 선언이다, \q 내가 네 목에서 그의 멍에를 꺾고 너를 묶은 줄을 끊어 버리겠다. \q 이방 사람들이 다시는 그를 종으로 부리지 못할 것이다.
ko.B: 그날에, 만군의 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}가 말한다, \q 내가 네 목에서 그의 멍에를 꺾고 너를 묶은 줄을 끊어 버리겠다. \q 이방 사람들이 다시는 그를 종으로 부리지 못할 것이다.
ko.R: 그날에, 하늘의 군대를 거느린 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}가 말한다, \q 내가 네 목에 씌워진 멍에를 꺾고 너를 묶은 사슬을 끊어 버리겠다. \q 외국 사람들이 다시는 내 백성을 종으로 부리지 못할 것이다.

pt.L: E acontecerá naquele dia, declara {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}} dos Exércitos, \q [que] quebrarei o jugo dele de cima do teu pescoço, e as tuas amarras arrebentarei, \q e estrangeiros não o farão mais servi-los.
pt.B: Naquele dia, declara {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}} dos Exércitos, \q quebrarei o jugo dele de cima do teu pescoço e arrebentarei as tuas amarras, \q e estrangeiros não o farão mais servi-los.
pt.R: Naquele dia, diz {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}} dos Exércitos, \q vou quebrar o jugo que está no teu pescoço e arrebentar as tuas correntes. \q Os estrangeiros nunca mais vão obrigar o {{deity_pronoun:meu|Meu}} povo a servi-los.

am.L: በዚያም ቀን እንዲህ ይሆናል፣ ይላል {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}} ጸባኦት፤ \q ቀንበሩን ከአንገትህ ላይ እሰብራለሁ፤ እስራትህንም እበጥሳለሁ፤ \q ከእንግዲህም ባዕዳን አያስገዙትም።
am.B: በዚያ ቀን፣ ይላል የሠራዊት አምላክ {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}}፣ \q ቀንበሩን ከአንገትህ ላይ እሰብራለሁ፤ እስራትህንም እበጥሳለሁ፤ \q ከእንግዲህም ባዕዳን አያስገዙትም።
am.R: በዚያ ቀን፣ ይላል የሠራዊት አምላክ {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}}፣ \q በአንገትህ ላይ ያለውን ቀንበር እሰብራለሁ፤ ሰንሰለትህንም እበጥሳለሁ። \q ከእንግዲህ ባዕዳን ሕዝቤን በግድ አያስገዙትም።

hi.L: और उस दिन ऐसा होगा, सेनाओं के {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} की यह वाणी है, \q [कि] मैं उसका जूआ तुम्हारी गर्दन पर से तोड़ दूँगा, और तुम्हारे बंधन तोड़ डालूँगा, \q और परदेशी फिर उससे [अपनी] सेवा न करवाएँगे।
hi.B: उस दिन, सेनाओं के {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} की यह वाणी है, \q मैं उसका जूआ तुम्हारी गर्दन पर से तोड़ दूँगा और तुम्हारे बंधन तोड़ डालूँगा, \q और परदेशी फिर उससे अपनी सेवा न करवाएँगे।
hi.R: उस दिन, सेनाओं के {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} कहते हैं, \q मैं तुम्हारी गर्दन पर रखा जूआ तोड़ दूँगा और तुम्हारी ज़ंजीरें तोड़ डालूँगा। \q परदेशी फिर कभी मेरे लोगों से ज़बरदस्ती अपनी सेवा नहीं करवाएँगे।

ru.L: И будет в тот день, — слово {{divine_name:ГОСПОДА|Яхве}} Саваофа, — \q {{deity_pronoun:я|Я}} сломаю его ярмо с твоей шеи и твои узы разорву, \q и не будут больше чужие порабощать его.
ru.B: В тот день, говорит {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Яхве}} Саваоф, \q {{deity_pronoun:я|Я}} сломаю его ярмо на твоей шее и разорву твои узы, \q и чужеземцы больше не заставят его служить им.
ru.R: В тот день, говорит {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Яхве}} Воинств, \q {{deity_pronoun:я|Я}} сломаю ярмо, которое на твоей шее, и разорву твои цепи. \q Чужеземцы больше никогда не заставят {{deity_pronoun:мой|Мой}} народ служить им.

ja.L: その日になると――万軍の{{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}の言葉――、 \q わたしはあなたの首から彼のくびきを砕き、あなたのかせを断ち切る。 \q よそ者たちは、もはや彼を[自分たちに]仕えさせない。
ja.B: その日には、と万軍の{{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}は告げる。 \q わたしは、あなたの首からそのくびきを砕き、あなたのかせを断ち切る。 \q 異国の者たちが、もはやヤコブを仕えさせることはない。
ja.R: その日には、と天の軍勢を率いる{{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}は言う。 \q わたしは、あなたの首にかけられたくびきを砕き、あなたの鎖を断ち切る。 \q 外国の人々が、わたしの民を力ずくで仕えさせることは、二度とない。

uk.L: І станеться того дня, говорить {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Ягве}} Саваот, \q [що] {{deity_pronoun:я|Я}} зламаю його ярмо з твоєї шиї, і твої пута розірву, \q і чужинці більше не змушуватимуть його служити [їм].
uk.B: Того дня, говорить {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Ягве}} Небесних Військ, \q {{deity_pronoun:я|Я}} зламаю його ярмо на твоїй шиї й розірву твої пута, \q і чужинці більше не змушуватимуть його служити їм.
uk.R: Того дня, каже {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Ягве}} Вседержитель, \q {{deity_pronoun:я|Я}} зламаю ярмо, що на твоїй шиї, і розірву твої кайдани. \q Чужинці ніколи більше не змушуватимуть {{deity_pronoun:мій|Мій}} народ служити їм.

decisions.choice: his yoke ... your neck ... him: the oppressor's yoke on Jacob, who is first spoken to and then spoken of
decisions.reason: "His yoke" is the yoke of the foreign master, the king of Babylon (27:8, 11; 28:14). "Your neck" and "your bonds" speak to Jacob, and "him" at the end speaks of Jacob; such changes of person are common in Hebrew poetry.

decisions.choice: I will break the yoke and tear off the bonds: the reversal of chapters 27-28
decisions.reason: Jeremiah wore a yoke as a sign of Babylon's rule, and when Hananiah broke it, the LORD said he would put an iron yoke on the nations (27:2; 28:10-14). Now the LORD himself promises to break it, in words that recall the exodus (Leviticus 26:13) and 2:20.

decisions.choice: make him serve: force Jacob into servitude
decisions.reason: With this preposition the verb means to make someone work for you, to hold them in bondage (25:14; 27:7). Verse 9 answers with the same verb: they will serve the LORD instead.

decisions.choice: serve, as in verse 9
decisions.reason: Each level keeps the verb "serve" so that the contrast with verse 9 can be heard: no longer serving foreigners, but serving the LORD (m3).

decisions.choice: the yoke that is on your neck ... my people
decisions.reason: Readable leaves out the unexplained "his" and says "my people" for "him", so the reader can follow who is meant (m1).

decisions.choice: katika siku ile (Literal); siku hiyo (Balanced); wakati huo (Readable)
decisions.reason: The settled Swahili for "in that day" at each level.

decisions.choice: "asserviront" (L, B), "obligeront ... à les servir" (R), set against "serviront" in verse 9
decisions.reason: French keeps the verb "servir" in both verses (asservir, servir) so that the contrast can be heard, as the English does.

decisions.choice: "trong ngày ấy" (L, B); "vào ngày ấy" (R)
decisions.reason: The terms note's forms for "in that day", used through chapters 30-31.

decisions.choice: "종으로 부리다" here and "섬기다" in verse 9
decisions.reason: The Hebrew uses one verb for serving foreigners and serving the LORD; Korean "섬기다" would honor the oppressors, so verse 8 says "종으로 부리다" and verse 9 "섬기다", and the contrast of masters is kept.

decisions.choice: o jugo, as amarras; tu (Jacob addressed as one)
decisions.reason: The yoke of chapters 27-28 (m2) keeps the word "jugo". Jacob, the whole people, is spoken to as one (m1), so "teu", as Isaiah speaks to Jacob in the singular with "tu", and spoken of as "ele/o" in the last line, as the Hebrew does.

decisions.choice: जूआ; बंधन (L, B), ज़ंजीरें (R)
decisions.reason: The yoke and the bonds keep the words of chapters 27-28 (जूआ, बंधन), so that the reversal of Jeremiah's sign can be heard (m2). The verb "serve" (सेवा) is kept here and in verse 9, as the English keeps it.

decisions.choice: ярмо; служить (verse 9)
decisions.reason: The yoke and the verb "serve" keep the wording of chapters 27-28, so that the reversal is heard: the yoke broken, and serving foreigners turned to serving the LORD in verse 9.

decisions.choice: 'ullo "彼のくびき" (L, keeping the Hebrew's "his" for the oppressor), "そのくびき" (B), "首にかけられたくびき" (R); ya'avdu vo "彼を仕えさせない" (L), "ヤコブを" (B), "わたしの民を" (R), as m1 (Jacob first addressed, then spoken of); zarim "よそ者たち" (L), "異国の者たち" (B), "外国の人々" (R).
decisions.reason: The yoke of 27-28 broken (m2): 'ol "くびき" as 28:2; 'avad "仕える" kept with verse 9.

records.literal_gloss: And they will serve Yahweh their God and David their king, whom I will raise up for them.

en.L: And they will serve {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} their God \q and David their king, whom I will raise up for them.
en.B: They will serve {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} their God instead \q and David their king, whom I will raise up for them.
en.R: Instead they will serve {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} their God \q and their king from David's family, whom I will raise up for them.

es.L: Sino que servirán {{divine_name:al SEÑOR|a Yahvé}} su Dios \q y a David su rey, a quien yo les levantaré.
es.B: Servirán, en cambio, {{divine_name:al SEÑOR|a Yahvé}} su Dios \q y a David su rey, a quien yo les levantaré.
es.R: En cambio, servirán {{divine_name:al SEÑOR|a Yahvé}} su Dios \q y a su rey de la familia de David, a quien yo les daré.

fr.L: Et ils serviront {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} leur Dieu \q et David leur roi, que je leur susciterai.
fr.B: Ils serviront plutôt {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} leur Dieu \q et David leur roi, que je leur susciterai.
fr.R: Ils serviront plutôt {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} leur Dieu \q et le roi de la famille de David, que je leur donnerai.

sw.L: Nao watamtumikia {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} Mungu wao \q na Daudi mfalme wao, nitakayewainulia.
sw.B: Badala yake watamtumikia {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} Mungu wao \q na Daudi mfalme wao, nitakayewainulia.
sw.R: Badala yake watamtumikia {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} Mungu wao \q na mfalme wao kutoka ukoo wa Daudi, nitakayewainulia.

vi.L: Nhưng họ sẽ phục vụ {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} Đức Chúa Trời của họ \q và Đa-vít vua của họ, là người {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} sẽ dấy lên cho họ.
vi.B: Thay vào đó, họ sẽ phục vụ {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} Đức Chúa Trời của họ \q và Đa-vít vua của họ, là người {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} sẽ dấy lên cho họ.
vi.R: Thay vào đó, họ sẽ phục vụ {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} Đức Chúa Trời của họ \q và vị vua thuộc dòng dõi Đa-vít mà {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} sẽ dấy lên cho họ.

ko.L: 그리고 그들은 그들의 하나님 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}와 \q 내가 그들을 위하여 일으킬 그들의 왕 다윗을 섬길 것이다.
ko.B: 그들은 그 대신 그들의 하나님 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}를 섬기고, \q 내가 그들을 위하여 일으킬 그들의 왕 다윗을 섬길 것이다.
ko.R: 그 대신 그들은 그들의 하나님 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}를 섬길 것이다. \q 그리고 내가 그들을 위하여 일으킬 다윗 집안의 왕을 섬길 것이다.

pt.L: E servirão {{divine_name:ao SENHOR|a Javé}}, o seu Deus, \q e a Davi, o seu rei, que eu levantarei para eles.
pt.B: Em vez disso, servirão {{divine_name:ao SENHOR|a Javé}}, o seu Deus, \q e a Davi, o seu rei, que eu levantarei para eles.
pt.R: Em vez disso, vão servir {{divine_name:ao SENHOR|a Javé}}, o seu Deus, \q e ao rei da família de Davi que eu vou levantar para eles.

am.L: አምላካቸውን {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔርን|ያህዌን}} \q የማስነሣላቸውንም ንጉሣቸውን ዳዊትን ያገለግላሉ።
am.B: ይልቁንም አምላካቸውን {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔርን|ያህዌን}} \q የማስነሣላቸውንም ንጉሣቸውን ዳዊትን ያገለግላሉ።
am.R: ይልቁንም አምላካቸውን {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔርን|ያህዌን}} \q የማስነሣላቸውንም ከዳዊት ቤተሰብ የሆነውን ንጉሣቸውን ያገለግላሉ።

hi.L: और वे {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} अपने परमेश्वर की \q और अपने राजा दाऊद की सेवा करेंगे, जिसे मैं उनके लिए खड़ा करूँगा।
hi.B: इसके बदले वे {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} अपने परमेश्वर की सेवा करेंगे \q और अपने राजा दाऊद की, जिसे मैं उनके लिए खड़ा करूँगा।
hi.R: इसके बदले वे {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} अपने परमेश्वर की सेवा करेंगे, \q और दाऊद के वंश के अपने राजा की, जिसे मैं उनके लिए खड़ा करूँगा।

ru.L: И будут они служить {{divine_name:ГОСПОДУ|Яхве}}, их Богу, \q и Давиду, их царю, которого {{deity_pronoun:я|Я}} воздвигну им.
ru.B: Вместо этого они будут служить {{divine_name:ГОСПОДУ|Яхве}}, своему Богу, \q и Давиду, своему царю, которого {{deity_pronoun:я|Я}} поставлю над ними.
ru.R: Вместо этого они будут служить {{divine_name:ГОСПОДУ|Яхве}}, своему Богу, \q и царю из рода Давида, которого {{deity_pronoun:я|Я}} поставлю над ними.

ja.L: 彼らは、彼らの神、{{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}と、 \q わたしが彼らのために起こす彼らの王ダビデに仕える。
ja.B: 彼らはむしろ、自分たちの神、{{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}と、 \q わたしが彼らのために立てる彼らの王ダビデに仕える。
ja.R: その代わり、彼らは自分たちの神、{{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}に仕える。 \q また、わたしが彼らのために立てる、ダビデの家から出る王に仕える。

uk.L: І вони служитимуть {{divine_name:ГОСПОДУ|Ягве}}, своєму Богові, \q і Давидові, своєму цареві, якого {{deity_pronoun:я|Я}} поставлю їм.
uk.B: Натомість вони служитимуть {{divine_name:ГОСПОДУ|Ягве}}, своєму Богові, \q і Давидові, своєму цареві, якого {{deity_pronoun:я|Я}} поставлю їм.
uk.R: Натомість вони служитимуть {{divine_name:ГОСПОДУ|Ягве}}, своєму Богові, \q і своєму цареві з роду Давида, якого {{deity_pronoun:я|Я}} поставлю їм.

decisions.choice: David their king: the promised king of David's line
decisions.reason: David had died some four hundred years before. The promise is of a ruler from his family who will be a second David (23:5-6; 33:15-17; Ezekiel 34:23-24; 37:24-25; Hosea 3:5). The New Testament sees this promise fulfilled in Jesus, the son of David (Luke 1:32-33; Acts 13:22-23).

decisions.choice: raise up: bring to power, appoint
decisions.reason: The verb is used of God setting up a leader or king (23:4-5; Judges 2:16; Amos 2:11). It does not mean raising from the dead.

decisions.choice: they will serve the LORD: the opposite of serving foreigners
decisions.reason: The verse picks up the verb of verse 8. Freed from foreign masters, the people will give their service to their own God and to the king he gives them.

decisions.choice: their king from David's family
decisions.reason: Readable says what "David" means here (m1), so the reader does not think of David himself coming back.

decisions.choice: Instead
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable spell out the contrast with verse 8 that the simple "and" carries (m3).

decisions.choice: "phục vụ" for serving the LORD; "phục dịch" for serving foreigners (verse 8)
decisions.reason: The Hebrew uses one verb, but Vietnamese "phục dịch" sounds like forced labour, which is right for verse 8 and wrong for the worship of God; meaning decision m3 notes the contrast.

decisions.choice: "다윗" without the honorific
decisions.reason: The promised king of David's line (meaning decision m1) is spoken of as the king of 23:5 is, without "-시-".

decisions.choice: David malkam "彼らの王ダビデ" (L, B), "ダビデの家から出る王" (R, as the English R; the promised king of David's line, m1); 'aqim "起こす" (L), "立てる" (B, R) (m2).
decisions.reason: R as JER 23:5 ja (ダビデの家から出る王).

source.text: וְאַתָּ֡ה אַל־תִּירָא֩ עַבְדִּ֨י יַעֲקֹ֤ב נְאֻם־יְהֹוָה֙ וְאַל־תֵּחַ֣ת יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל כִּ֠י הִנְנִ֤י מוֹשִֽׁיעֲךָ֙ מֵֽרָח֔וֹק וְאֶֽת־זַרְעֲךָ֖ מֵאֶ֣רֶץ שִׁבְיָ֑ם וְשָׁ֧ב יַעֲקֹ֛ב וְשָׁקַ֥ט וְשַׁאֲנַ֖ן וְאֵ֥ין מַחֲרִֽיד׃

records.literal_gloss: And you, do not fear, my servant Jacob, declares Yahweh, and do not be dismayed, Israel; for look, I [am] saving you from afar, and your offspring from [the] land of their captivity; and Jacob will return and be quiet and be at ease, and there [will be] none making [him] afraid.

en.L: And you, do not fear, {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} servant Jacob, declares {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}, and do not be dismayed, Israel, \q for look, I am saving you from far away, and your offspring from the land of their captivity. \q And Jacob will return and be quiet and at ease, and there will be no one to make [him] afraid.
en.B: So you, Jacob {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} servant, do not be afraid, declares {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}; do not be dismayed, Israel. \q For I will save you from a far country, and your descendants from the land where they are captives. \q Jacob will come home and have quiet and rest, and no one will make him afraid.
en.R: So do not be afraid, Jacob, {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} servant, says {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}. Israel, do not be frightened. \q I will save you from a land far away. I will save your children from the land where they are prisoners. \q The people of Jacob will come home. They will live in peace and safety, and no one will frighten them.

es.L: Y tú, no temas, siervo {{deity_pronoun:mío|Mío}} Jacob, declara {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}}, ni te espantes, Israel, \q porque he aquí, yo te salvo de lejos, y a tu descendencia de la tierra de su cautiverio. \q Y Jacob volverá, y estará tranquilo y seguro, y no habrá quien [lo] atemorice.
es.B: Así que tú, Jacob, siervo {{deity_pronoun:mío|Mío}}, no tengas miedo, afirma {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}}; no te espantes, Israel. \q Porque yo te salvaré de un país lejano, y a tus descendientes de la tierra donde están cautivos. \q Jacob volverá a casa y tendrá tranquilidad y reposo, y nadie lo atemorizará.
es.R: Así que no tengas miedo, Jacob, siervo {{deity_pronoun:mío|Mío}}, dice {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}}. Israel, no te asustes. \q Yo te salvaré de una tierra lejana. Salvaré a tus hijos de la tierra donde están prisioneros. \q El pueblo de Jacob volverá a casa. Vivirá en paz y seguridad, y nadie lo asustará.

fr.L: Et toi, ne crains pas, {{deity_pronoun:mon|Mon}} serviteur Jacob, déclare {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}, et ne t’effraie pas, Israël, \q car voici, je te sauve du lointain, et ta descendance du pays de sa captivité. \q Et Jacob reviendra, il sera tranquille et en paix, et personne ne [l’]effraiera.
fr.B: Toi donc, Jacob {{deity_pronoun:mon|Mon}} serviteur, n’aie pas peur, déclare {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} ; ne t’effraie pas, Israël. \q Car je te sauverai d’un pays lointain, et tes descendants du pays où ils sont captifs. \q Jacob reviendra et vivra dans le calme et le repos, et personne ne lui fera peur.
fr.R: N’aie donc pas peur, Jacob, {{deity_pronoun:mon|Mon}} serviteur, dit {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}. Israël, ne sois pas effrayé. \q Je te sauverai d’un pays lointain. Je sauverai tes enfants du pays où ils sont prisonniers. \q Le peuple de Jacob reviendra chez lui. Il vivra en paix et en sécurité, et personne ne lui fera peur.

sw.L: Nawe, usiogope, mtumishi {{deity_pronoun:wangu|Wangu}} Yakobo, asema {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, wala usifadhaike, Israeli, \q kwa maana tazama, ninakuokoa kutoka mbali, na uzao wako kutoka nchi ya utumwa wao. \q Naye Yakobo atarudi na kutulia na kustarehe, wala hakuna atakayemtia hofu.
sw.B: Basi wewe, Yakobo mtumishi {{deity_pronoun:wangu|Wangu}}, usiogope, asema {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}; usifadhaike, Israeli. \q Kwa maana nitakuokoa kutoka nchi ya mbali, na wazao wako kutoka nchi wanamoshikiliwa mateka. \q Yakobo atarudi nyumbani na kupata utulivu na raha, wala hakuna atakayemtia hofu.
sw.R: Basi usiogope, Yakobo, mtumishi {{deity_pronoun:wangu|Wangu}}, anasema {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}. Israeli, usitishike. \q Nitakuokoa kutoka nchi ya mbali. Nitawaokoa watoto wako kutoka nchi wanamoshikiliwa kama wafungwa. \q Watu wa Yakobo watarudi nyumbani. Wataishi kwa amani na usalama, wala hakuna atakayewatisha.

vi.L: Còn ngươi, hỡi Gia-cốp đầy tớ {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}}, đừng sợ, {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} phán vậy; hỡi Y-sơ-ra-ên, đừng kinh hãi, \q vì kìa, {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} sẽ cứu ngươi từ phương xa, và dòng dõi ngươi khỏi xứ chúng bị lưu đày. \q Gia-cốp sẽ trở về, được yên tĩnh và an ổn, chẳng còn ai làm [nó] sợ hãi.
vi.B: Vậy, hỡi Gia-cốp đầy tớ {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}}, con đừng sợ, {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} phán vậy; hỡi Y-sơ-ra-ên, đừng kinh hãi. \q Vì {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} sẽ cứu con từ một xứ xa xôi, và cứu dòng dõi con khỏi xứ chúng đang bị lưu đày. \q Gia-cốp sẽ trở về, được yên tĩnh và nghỉ ngơi, chẳng còn ai làm nó sợ hãi.
vi.R: Vậy hỡi Gia-cốp đầy tớ {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}}, con đừng sợ, {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} phán. Hỡi Y-sơ-ra-ên, đừng hoảng sợ. \q Ta sẽ cứu con từ một xứ xa xôi. Ta sẽ cứu con cháu con khỏi xứ chúng đang bị giam cầm. \q Dân Gia-cốp sẽ trở về quê hương. Họ sẽ sống bình an và yên ổn, chẳng còn ai làm họ sợ hãi.

ko.L: 그러니 너, 내 종 야곱아, 두려워하지 마라. {{divine_name:주|야훼}}의 선언이다. 이스라엘아, 놀라지 마라. \q 보아라, 내가 너를 먼 곳에서 구원하고, 네 자손을 포로로 잡혀 있는 땅에서 구원하겠다. \q 야곱이 돌아와서 평온하고 안락하게 살 것이며, 아무도 [그를] 두렵게 하지 못할 것이다.
ko.B: 그러니 내 종 야곱아, 두려워하지 마라. {{divine_name:주|야훼}}가 말한다. 이스라엘아, 놀라지 마라. \q 내가 너를 먼 나라에서 구원하고, 네 자손을 포로로 잡혀 있는 땅에서 구원하겠다. \q 야곱이 돌아와서 평온하고 편안하게 살 것이며, 아무도 그를 두렵게 하지 못할 것이다.
ko.R: 그러니 내 종 야곱아, 두려워하지 마라. {{divine_name:주|야훼}}가 말한다. 이스라엘아, 겁내지 마라. \q 내가 먼 나라에서 너를 구원하겠다. 포로로 잡혀 있는 땅에서 네 자손을 구원하겠다. \q 야곱의 자손이 집으로 돌아올 것이다. 그들은 평안하고 안전하게 살 것이며, 아무도 그들을 겁주지 못할 것이다.

pt.L: E tu, não temas, {{deity_pronoun:meu|Meu}} servo Jacó, declara {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}}, e não te apavores, Israel, \q pois eis que eu te salvo de longe, e a tua descendência, da terra do seu cativeiro. \q E Jacó voltará e terá sossego e tranquilidade, e não haverá quem [o] amedronte.
pt.B: Portanto, tu, Jacó, {{deity_pronoun:meu|Meu}} servo, não tenhas medo, declara {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}}; não te apavores, Israel. \q Pois eu te salvarei de uma terra distante, e os teus descendentes, da terra onde estão cativos. \q Jacó voltará para casa e terá sossego e descanso, e ninguém o amedrontará.
pt.R: Portanto, não tenhas medo, Jacó, {{deity_pronoun:meu|Meu}} servo, diz {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}}. Israel, não te assustes. \q Vou te salvar de uma terra distante. Vou salvar os teus filhos da terra onde eles são prisioneiros. \q O povo de Jacó vai voltar para casa. Eles vão viver em paz e segurança, e ninguém vai assustá-los.

am.L: አንተም ባሪያዬ ያዕቆብ ሆይ፣ አትፍራ፣ ይላል {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}}፤ እስራኤል ሆይ፣ አትደንግጥ፤ \q እነሆ፣ አንተን ከሩቅ፣ ዘርህንም ከምርኮአቸው ምድር አድናለሁና። \q ያዕቆብም ይመለሳል፤ ያርፋል፤ ተረጋግቶም ይቀመጣል፤ የሚያስፈራውም አይኖርም።
am.B: ስለዚህ አንተ አገልጋዬ ያዕቆብ ሆይ፣ አትፍራ፣ ይላል {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}}፤ እስራኤል ሆይ፣ አትደንግጥ። \q አንተን ከሩቅ አገር፣ ዘርህንም ከተማረኩበት ምድር አድናለሁና። \q ያዕቆብ ወደ አገሩ ይመለሳል፤ ጸጥታና ዕረፍት ያገኛል፤ የሚያስፈራውም አይኖርም።
am.R: ስለዚህ አገልጋዬ ያዕቆብ ሆይ፣ አትፍራ፣ ይላል {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}}። እስራኤል ሆይ፣ አትሸበር። \q ከሩቅ አገር አድንሃለሁ። ልጆችህንም ከተማረኩበት ምድር አድናቸዋለሁ። \q የያዕቆብ ሕዝብ ወደ አገራቸው ይመለሳሉ። በሰላምና በደኅንነት ይኖራሉ፤ የሚያስፈራቸውም አይኖርም።

hi.L: और तुम, हे मेरे दास याकूब, मत डरो, {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} की यह वाणी है, और हे इस्राएल, घबराओ मत, \q क्योंकि देखो, मैं तुम्हें दूर देश से, और तुम्हारे वंश को उनकी बंधुआई के देश से बचाता हूँ। \q और याकूब लौट आएगा और चैन से और निश्चिंत रहेगा, और उसे डरानेवाला कोई न होगा।
hi.B: इसलिए हे मेरे दास याकूब, तुम मत डरो, {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} की यह वाणी है; हे इस्राएल, घबराओ मत। \q क्योंकि मैं तुम्हें दूर देश से, और तुम्हारे वंश को उस देश से जहाँ वे बंधुए हैं, बचाऊँगा। \q याकूब घर लौटेगा और चैन और विश्राम पाएगा, और कोई उसे नहीं डराएगा।
hi.R: इसलिए हे याकूब, मेरे दास, मत डरो, {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} कहते हैं। हे इस्राएल, भयभीत मत हो। \q मैं तुम्हें दूर के देश से बचाऊँगा। मैं तुम्हारे बच्चों को उस देश से बचाऊँगा जहाँ वे बंदी हैं। \q याकूब के लोग घर लौटेंगे। वे शान्ति और सुरक्षा से रहेंगे, और कोई उन्हें नहीं डराएगा।

ru.L: А ты не бойся, {{deity_pronoun:мой|Мой}} раб Иаков, — слово {{divine_name:ГОСПОДА|Яхве}}, — и не ужасайся, Израиль, \q потому что вот, {{deity_pronoun:я|Я}} спасаю тебя издалека и твоё потомство из земли их плена. \q И вернётся Иаков, и будет в покое и безопасности, и не будет никого, кто устрашит [его].
ru.B: Итак, ты, Иаков, {{deity_pronoun:мой|Мой}} раб, не бойся, говорит {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Яхве}}; не ужасайся, Израиль. \q Ведь {{deity_pronoun:я|Я}} спасу тебя из далёкой страны и твоих потомков из земли, где они в плену. \q Иаков вернётся домой, будет жить в покое и мире, и никто не будет его пугать.
ru.R: Поэтому не бойся, Иаков, {{deity_pronoun:мой|Мой}} раб, говорит {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Яхве}}. Израиль, не пугайся. \q Я спасу тебя из далёкой земли. Я спасу твоих детей из земли, где они в плену. \q Народ Иакова вернётся домой. Они будут жить в мире и безопасности, и никто не будет их пугать.

ja.L: あなたは、恐れるな、わたしのしもべヤコブよ――{{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}の言葉――。おののくな、イスラエルよ。 \q 見なさい、わたしは遠くからあなたを、捕囚の地からあなたの子孫を救う。 \q ヤコブは帰って来て、平穏に、安らかに暮らし、彼を脅かす者はいない。
ja.B: わたしのしもべヤコブよ、あなたは恐れてはならない、と{{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}は告げる。イスラエルよ、おびえてはならない。 \q わたしは、遠い国からあなたを、捕らわれている地からあなたの子孫を救う。 \q ヤコブは帰って来て、平穏に安らかに暮らし、彼を脅かす者はだれもいない。
ja.R: だから、わたしのしもべヤコブよ、恐れてはいけない、と{{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}は言う。イスラエルよ、怖がってはいけない。 \q わたしは、遠い国からあなたを救う。捕虜になっている地から、あなたの子どもたちを救う。 \q ヤコブの民は、ふるさとに帰って来る。彼らは平和に安心して暮らし、だれも彼らを脅かさない。

uk.L: А ти не бійся, {{deity_pronoun:мій|Мій}} рабе Якове, говорить {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Ягве}}, і не лякайся, Ізраїлю, \q бо ось {{deity_pronoun:я|Я}} спасаю тебе здалека, і твоє потомство із землі їхнього полону. \q І повернеться Яків, і буде спокійний і безтурботний, і не буде нікого, хто [його] лякав би.
uk.B: Тож ти не бійся, Якове, {{deity_pronoun:мій|Мій}} рабе, говорить {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Ягве}}; не лякайся, Ізраїлю. \q Бо {{deity_pronoun:я|Я}} спасу тебе з далекого краю, і твоїх нащадків із землі, де вони в полоні. \q Яків повернеться додому, матиме спокій і відпочинок, і ніхто його не лякатиме.
uk.R: Тож не бійся, Якове, {{deity_pronoun:мій|Мій}} рабе, каже {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Ягве}}. Ізраїлю, не лякайся. \q Я врятую тебе з далекої землі. Я врятую твоїх дітей із землі, де вони в полоні. \q Нащадки Якова повернуться додому. Вони житимуть у мирі й безпеці, і ніхто не лякатиме їх.

decisions.choice: do not fear, my servant Jacob: words repeated at 46:27-28
decisions.reason: Verses 10-11 return almost word for word at the end of the oracle against Egypt (46:27-28). They also echo Isaiah's words to Israel as the LORD's servant (Isaiah 41:8-10; 43:5; 44:2).

decisions.choice: my servant: Israel as the people the LORD has chosen and keeps
decisions.reason: To be the LORD's servant is to belong to him and be under his protection. It is a title of honor here, not of bondage (Isaiah 41:8-9; 44:1-2).

decisions.choice: verses 10-11 kept here, as the Hebrew text has them
decisions.reason: The Greek translation of Jeremiah does not have verses 10-11 in this chapter; it has them only in its form of 46:27-28. The Hebrew text, which this translation follows, has them in both places.

decisions.choice: I am saving you from far away: a sure promise, spoken as if it were already under way
decisions.reason: The participle describes what the LORD is about to do and is already setting in motion. "From far away" means from a distant land, the land of exile.

decisions.choice: do not fear / do not be afraid; do not be dismayed / do not be frightened
decisions.reason: These verses are to keep one wording here and at 46:27-28 (m1), so that a reader hears the same promise in both places.

decisions.choice: The people of Jacob ... They ... them
decisions.reason: Readable says "the people of Jacob", as Isaiah's Readable does, so that the plural pronouns follow.

decisions.choice: mtumishi wangu Yakobo
decisions.reason: God's servant is "mtumishi" at every level, never "mtumwa", as the terms note sets; the deity span is on God's "wangu", not on Jacob.

decisions.choice: "ne crains pas / n'aie pas peur"; "ne t'effraie pas / ne sois pas effrayé"
decisions.reason: One wording for the promise here and at 46:27-28, as the English sets it, so that a reader hears the same promise in both places.

decisions.choice: God says "ngươi" (L) and "con" (B, R) to Jacob, "đầy tớ Ta"
decisions.reason: The terms note: Israel or Jacob addressed as one person is "ngươi" at Literal and "con" at Balanced and Readable, as in Isaiah 41:8-14; "đầy tớ" holds at every level. This covers verses 8-17.

decisions.choice: "내 종 야곱"
decisions.reason: The terms note's "내 종" for God's servant at Balanced and Readable; Literal follows it here too, since Korean "나의" would sound stiff in direct address.

decisions.choice: não temas (L), não tenhas medo (B, R), meu servo Jacó; não te apavores (L, B), não te assustes (R)
decisions.reason: The words return at 46:27-28 (m1) and echo Isaiah 41:10 and 44:2, so each level keeps Isaiah's Portuguese for "do not fear, my servant Jacob" ("não temas" at Literal, "não tenhas medo" at Balanced and Readable); 46:27-28 should repeat this verse's wording. "Meu servo" is a title of honor at every level (m2).

decisions.choice: Verses 10-11 drafted here for 46:27-28 to copy
decisions.reason: The same words come again at 46:27-28; where the Hebrew is the same, that passage should keep this Amharic level by level. My servant is "ባሪያዬ" (Literal), "አገልጋዬ" (Balanced, Readable).

decisions.choice: मत डरो ... घबराओ मत (L, B); मत डरो ... भयभीत मत हो (R); मेरा दास याकूब
decisions.reason: The words are repeated at 46:27-28 (m1), which copies this wording at each level. "My servant" is दास, as everywhere for ʿeved.

decisions.choice: мой раб Иаков; не бойся ... не ужасайся
decisions.reason: Verses 10-11 return at 46:27-28; this wording is offered for both places. Israel as God's ʿeved is "раб" at every level, as the notes set.

decisions.choice: 'al tira' 'avdi Ya'aqov "恐れるな、わたしのしもべヤコブよ" (L), "恐れてはならない" (B), "恐れてはいけない" (R), the oracle prohibitions and "わたしのしもべ" at every level (ISA-6, ISA 44:2 ja); 'al techat "おののくな" (L), "おびえてはならない" (B), "怖がってはいけない" (R); shav Ya'aqov "帰って来て", the plain sense of shuv (home), not "立ち帰る".
decisions.reason: Verses 10-11 return at 46:27-28 (m1): a later drafter should copy this Japanese there.

source.text: כִּֽי־אִתְּךָ֥ אֲנִ֛י נְאֻם־יְהוָ֖ה לְהֽוֹשִׁיעֶ֑ךָ כִּי֩ אֶעֱשֶׂ֨ה כָלָ֜ה בְּכָֽל־הַגּוֹיִ֣ם׀אֲשֶׁ֧ר הֲפִצוֹתִ֣יךָ שָּׁ֗ם אַ֤ךְ אֹֽתְךָ֙ לֹֽא־אֶעֱשֶׂ֣ה כָלָ֔ה וְיִסַּרְתִּ֨יךָ֙ לַמִּשְׁפָּ֔ט וְנַקֵּ֖ה לֹ֥א אֲנַקֶּֽךָּ׃פ

records.literal_gloss: For with you I [am], declares Yahweh, to save you; for I will make [a] full end of all the nations where I have scattered you there, but you I will not make [a] full end [of]; and I will discipline you in justice, and leaving unpunished I will not leave you unpunished.

en.L: For I [am] with you, declares {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}, to save you. \q For I will make a full end of all the nations where I have scattered you, but of you I will not make a full end. \q I will discipline you in just measure, \q and I will by no means leave you unpunished.
en.B: For I am with you to save you, declares {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}. \q I will bring to an end all the nations among whom I scattered you, but you I will not bring to an end. \q I will discipline you, but justly, \q and I will not let you go unpunished.
en.R: I am with you, and I will save you, says {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}. \q I will completely destroy all the nations where I scattered you. But I will not completely destroy you. \q I will correct you, but I will be fair, \q and I will not let you escape all punishment.

es.L: Porque yo [estoy] contigo, declara {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}}, para salvarte. \q Porque acabaré del todo con todas las naciones entre las que te esparcí, pero contigo no acabaré del todo. \q Te corregiré con justa medida, \q y de ninguna manera te dejaré sin castigo.
es.B: Porque yo estoy contigo para salvarte, afirma {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}}. \q Acabaré con todas las naciones entre las que te dispersé, pero contigo no acabaré. \q Te corregiré, pero con justicia, \q y no te dejaré sin castigo.
es.R: Yo estoy contigo, y te salvaré, dice {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}}. \q Destruiré por completo a todas las naciones por donde te dispersé. Pero a ti no te destruiré por completo. \q Te corregiré, pero seré justo, \q y no dejaré que te libres de todo castigo.

fr.L: Car je [suis] avec toi, déclare {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}, pour te sauver. \q Car j’anéantirai toutes les nations parmi lesquelles je t’ai dispersé, mais toi, je ne t’anéantirai pas. \q Je te corrigerai avec mesure, \q et je ne te laisserai certainement pas impuni.
fr.B: Car je suis avec toi pour te sauver, déclare {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}. \q J’en finirai avec toutes les nations parmi lesquelles je t’ai dispersé, mais avec toi, je n’en finirai pas. \q Je te corrigerai, mais avec justice, \q et je ne te laisserai pas impuni.
fr.R: Je suis avec toi, et je te sauverai, dit {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}. \q Je détruirai complètement toutes les nations où je t’ai dispersé. Mais toi, je ne te détruirai pas complètement. \q Je te corrigerai, mais je serai juste, \q et je ne te laisserai pas échapper à toute punition.

sw.L: Kwa maana {{deity_pronoun:mimi|Mimi}} [ni] pamoja nawe, asema {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, ili nikuokoe. \q Kwa maana nitayakomesha kabisa mataifa yote nilikokutawanya, lakini wewe sitakukomesha kabisa. \q Nitakurudi kwa kipimo cha haki, \q wala sitakuacha kamwe bila adhabu.
sw.B: Kwa maana {{deity_pronoun:mimi|Mimi}} niko pamoja nawe ili nikuokoe, asema {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}. \q Nitayamaliza kabisa mataifa yote ambamo nilikutawanya, lakini wewe sitakumaliza. \q Nitakuadibisha, lakini kwa haki, \q wala sitakuacha bila adhabu.
sw.R: Mimi niko pamoja nawe, nami nitakuokoa, anasema {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}. \q Nitayaangamiza kabisa mataifa yote nilikokutawanya. Lakini wewe sitakuangamiza kabisa. \q Nitakurekebisha, lakini nitakuwa wa haki, \q wala sitakuacha uepuke adhabu yote.

vi.L: Vì {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} ở với ngươi, {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} phán vậy, để cứu ngươi. \q Vì {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} sẽ tận diệt mọi dân tộc mà {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} đã làm cho ngươi tan lạc đến, nhưng ngươi thì {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} sẽ không tận diệt. \q Ta sẽ sửa phạt ngươi theo mức công bằng, \q và {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} chắc chắn không để ngươi khỏi bị phạt.
vi.B: Vì {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} ở với con để cứu con, {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} phán vậy. \q Ta sẽ tận diệt mọi dân tộc mà {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} đã làm cho con tan lạc đến, nhưng con thì {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} sẽ không tận diệt. \q Ta sẽ sửa phạt con, nhưng cách công bằng, \q và {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} sẽ không để con khỏi bị phạt.
vi.R: Ta ở với con, và {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} sẽ cứu con, {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} phán. \q Ta sẽ tiêu diệt hoàn toàn mọi dân tộc nơi {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} đã làm cho con tan lạc đến. Nhưng {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} sẽ không tiêu diệt con hoàn toàn. \q Ta sẽ sửa dạy con, nhưng {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} sẽ công bằng, \q và {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} sẽ không để con thoát mọi hình phạt.

ko.L: 내가 너와 함께 있어 너를 구원할 것이다. {{divine_name:주|야훼}}의 선언이다. \q 내가 너를 흩어 보낸 모든 민족은 완전히 멸망시키겠지만, 너만은 완전히 멸망시키지 않겠다. \q 내가 너를 법도에 따라 징계하겠고, \q 결코 너를 벌하지 않은 채 두지는 않겠다.
ko.B: 내가 너와 함께 있어 너를 구원하겠다. {{divine_name:주|야훼}}가 말한다. \q 내가 너를 흩어 보낸 모든 민족은 끝장을 내겠지만, 너만은 끝장내지 않겠다. \q 내가 너를 징계하되 공정하게 하겠고, \q 너를 벌하지 않고 그냥 두지는 않겠다.
ko.R: 내가 너와 함께 있어 너를 구원하겠다. {{divine_name:주|야훼}}가 말한다. \q 내가 너를 흩어 보낸 모든 나라는 완전히 멸망시키겠다. 그러나 너는 완전히 멸망시키지 않겠다. \q 내가 너를 바로잡겠지만 공정하게 하겠다. \q 그러나 너를 아무 벌도 없이 그냥 두지는 않겠다.

pt.L: Pois contigo eu [estou], declara {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}}, para te salvar. \q Pois darei fim completo a todas as nações entre as quais te espalhei, mas a ti não darei fim completo. \q Eu te disciplinarei com justiça \q e de modo algum te deixarei impune.
pt.B: Pois eu estou contigo para te salvar, declara {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}}. \q Acabarei com todas as nações entre as quais te espalhei, mas contigo não acabarei. \q Eu te disciplinarei, mas com justiça, \q e não te deixarei sem castigo.
pt.R: Eu estou contigo e vou te salvar, diz {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}}. \q Vou destruir completamente todas as nações para onde te espalhei. Mas a ti não vou destruir completamente. \q Vou te corrigir, mas com justiça, \q e não vou deixar que escapes de todo castigo.

am.L: አድንህ ዘንድ እኔ ከአንተ ጋር ነኝና፣ ይላል {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}}። \q በመካከላቸው የበተንኩህን ሕዝቦች ሁሉ ፈጽሜ አጠፋለሁ፤ አንተን ግን ፈጽሜ አላጠፋህም። \q በፍርድ እገሥጽሃለሁ፤ \q ያለ ቅጣትም ፈጽሞ አልተውህም።
am.B: አድንህ ዘንድ ከአንተ ጋር ነኝና፣ ይላል {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}}። \q የበተንኩህን ሕዝቦች ሁሉ ፈጽሜ አጠፋለሁ፤ አንተን ግን ፈጽሜ አላጠፋህም። \q እገሥጽሃለሁ፤ ነገር ግን በፍትሕ ነው፤ \q ያለ ቅጣትም አልተውህም።
am.R: እኔ ከአንተ ጋር ነኝ፤ አድንሃለሁም፣ ይላል {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}}። \q የበተንኩህን ሕዝቦች ሁሉ ፈጽሜ አጠፋቸዋለሁ። አንተን ግን ፈጽሜ አላጠፋህም። \q አርምሃለሁ፤ ነገር ግን በትክክል ነው፤ \q ያለ ቅጣትም አልተውህም።

hi.L: क्योंकि मैं तुम्हारे साथ [हूँ], {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} की यह वाणी है, कि तुम्हें बचाऊँ। \q क्योंकि जिन जातियों में मैंने तुम्हें तितर-बितर किया है, उन सब का मैं पूरी तरह अंत कर दूँगा, पर तुम्हारा मैं पूरी तरह अंत न करूँगा। \q मैं न्याय के साथ तुम्हें ताड़ना दूँगा, \q और तुम्हें किसी भी तरह बिना दंड के न छोड़ूँगा।
hi.B: क्योंकि तुम्हें बचाने के लिए मैं तुम्हारे साथ हूँ, {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} की यह वाणी है। \q जिन जिन देशों में मैंने तुम्हें तितर-बितर किया, उन सब का मैं अंत कर दूँगा, पर तुम्हारा अंत न करूँगा। \q मैं तुम्हें ताड़ना दूँगा, पर न्याय के साथ, \q और तुम्हें बिना दंड के न छोड़ूँगा।
hi.R: मैं तुम्हारे साथ हूँ, और मैं तुम्हें बचाऊँगा, {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} कहते हैं। \q जिन देशों में मैंने तुम्हें तितर-बितर किया, उन सब को मैं पूरी तरह नष्ट कर दूँगा। पर तुम्हें मैं पूरी तरह नष्ट नहीं करूँगा। \q मैं तुम्हें सुधारूँगा, पर उचित रीति से, \q और तुम्हें पूरी तरह दंड से बचने नहीं दूँगा।

ru.L: Ведь с тобой {{deity_pronoun:я|Я}}, — слово {{divine_name:ГОСПОДА|Яхве}}, — чтобы спасать тебя; \q ведь {{deity_pronoun:я|Я}} совершенно истреблю все народы, среди которых {{deity_pronoun:я|Я}} рассеял тебя, но тебя не истреблю совершенно. \q Я накажу тебя по справедливости \q и ни за что не оставлю тебя безнаказанным.
ru.B: Ведь {{deity_pronoun:я|Я}} с тобой, чтобы спасти тебя, говорит {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Яхве}}. \q Я положу конец всем народам, среди которых рассеял тебя, но тебе не положу конца. \q Я накажу тебя, но справедливо, \q и не оставлю тебя безнаказанным.
ru.R: Я с тобой и спасу тебя, говорит {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Яхве}}. \q Я полностью уничтожу все народы, среди которых рассеял тебя. Но тебя {{deity_pronoun:я|Я}} полностью не уничтожу. \q Я буду исправлять тебя, но справедливо, \q и не оставлю тебя совсем без наказания.

ja.L: わたしがあなたと共にいて――{{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}の言葉――、あなたを救うからだ。 \q わたしは、あなたを散らしたすべての国々を滅ぼし尽くすが、あなただけは滅ぼし尽くさない。 \q わたしは正しい裁きをもってあなたを懲らしめ、 \q あなたを罰せずにおくことは決してしない。
ja.B: わたしがあなたと共にいて、あなたを救うからだ、と{{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}は告げる。 \q わたしは、あなたを散らした先のすべての国々を滅ぼし尽くす。しかし、あなたを滅ぼし尽くすことはしない。 \q わたしはあなたを懲らしめる。だが、ほどよく懲らしめる。 \q あなたを罰せずにおくことはしない。
ja.R: わたしはあなたと一緒にいて、あなたを救う、と{{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}は言う。 \q わたしは、あなたを散らしたすべての国々を、すっかり滅ぼす。しかし、あなたをすっかり滅ぼすことはしない。 \q わたしはあなたを正す。だが、公平に正す。 \q あなたが罰をまったく受けずにすむことはない。

uk.L: Бо {{deity_pronoun:я|Я}} з тобою, говорить {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Ягве}}, щоб спасати тебе. \q Бо {{deity_pronoun:я|Я}} вчиню кінець усім народам, між якими розпорошив тебе, а тобі не вчиню кінця. \q Я картатиму тебе за правом \q і ніяк не залишу тебе без кари.
uk.B: Бо {{deity_pronoun:я|Я}} з тобою, щоб спасти тебе, говорить {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Ягве}}. \q Я покладу кінець усім народам, між якими розпорошив тебе, а тобі не покладу кінця. \q Я картатиму тебе, але справедливо, \q і не залишу тебе без кари.
uk.R: Я з тобою, і {{deity_pronoun:я|Я}} врятую тебе, каже {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Ягве}}. \q Я цілком знищу всі народи, між якими розпорошив тебе. Але тебе {{deity_pronoun:я|Я}} не знищу цілком. \q Я виправлятиму тебе, але буду справедливим, \q і не дам тобі зовсім уникнути кари.

decisions.choice: I am with you to save you: the promise first given to Jeremiah, now given to the people
decisions.reason: At his call the LORD told Jeremiah, "I am with you to rescue you" (1:8, 19; 15:20). Here the same assurance is given to the whole people.

decisions.choice: a full end: complete destruction
decisions.reason: The word means a finishing off, total ruin (4:27; 5:10, 18). The nations that held Israel will come to such an end; Israel will not.

decisions.choice: discipline you in justice: correct you in fair measure, not to destroy you
decisions.reason: Jeremiah prayed, "Correct me, LORD, but in justice, not in your anger, or you will bring me to nothing" (10:24). The LORD's discipline has a limit and a purpose.

decisions.choice: leaving unpunished I will not leave you unpunished: I will certainly not let you go free of punishment
decisions.reason: Hebrew repeats the verb to make it emphatic. The words recall the LORD's self-description in Exodus 34:7 and Numbers 14:18: he forgives, but he does not simply ignore guilt.

decisions.choice: I will correct you, but I will be fair
decisions.reason: Readable says plainly what "in justice" means here (m3).

decisions.choice: kalah "滅ぼし尽くす" (L, B), "すっかり滅ぼす" (R) (m2); yissartikha lammishpat "正しい裁きをもって懲らしめ" (L), "ほどよく懲らしめる" (B), "公平に正す" (R), as JER 10:24 ja (m3); venaqqeh lo' 'anaqqekka "罰せずにおくことは決してしない" (L), the doubled verb as "決して" (m4).
decisions.reason: hoshia' "救う" (every level), not the hatsil row of 1:8, 1:19.

source.text: כִּ֣י כֹ֥ה אָמַ֛ר יְהוָ֖ה אָנ֣וּשׁ לְשִׁבְרֵ֑ךְ נַחְלָ֖ה מַכָּתֵֽךְ׃

records.literal_gloss: For thus says Yahweh: Incurable [is] your fracture, grievous [is] your wound.

en.L: For thus says {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}: Incurable [is] your fracture, \q grievous your wound.
en.B: For {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} says this: Your injury cannot be cured; \q your wound is severe.
en.R: This is what {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} says: Your injury cannot be healed. \q Your wound is very bad.

es.L: Porque así dice {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}}: Incurable [es] tu quebranto, \q grave tu herida.
es.B: Porque {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} dice esto: Tu lesión no tiene cura; \q tu herida es grave.
es.R: Esto es lo que dice {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}}: Tu lesión no se puede sanar. \q Tu herida es muy grave.

fr.L: Car ainsi parle {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} : Incurable [est] ta fracture, \q grave ta blessure.
fr.B: Car {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} dit ceci : Ta blessure est incurable ; \q ta plaie est grave.
fr.R: Voici ce que dit {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} : Ta blessure ne peut pas guérir. \q Ta plaie est très grave.

sw.L: Kwa maana {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} asema hivi: Jeraha lako [ni] lisiloponyeka, \q pigo lako ni zito.
sw.B: Kwa maana hivi ndivyo {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} asemavyo: Jeraha lako haliwezi kuponywa; \q kidonda chako ni kibaya sana.
sw.R: Hili ndilo {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} analosema: Jeraha lako haliwezi kuponywa. \q Kidonda chako ni kibaya sana.

vi.L: Vì {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} phán thế này: Vết gãy của ngươi không chữa được, \q vết thương của ngươi trầm trọng.
vi.B: Vì {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} phán như vầy: Thương tích của con không chữa được; \q vết thương của con thật trầm trọng.
vi.R: Đây là lời {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} phán: Thương tích của con không thể lành. \q Vết thương của con rất nặng.

ko.L: {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 이와 같이 말씀하신다. 네 부러진 곳은 고칠 수 없고, \q 네 상처는 중하다.
ko.B: {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 이렇게 말씀하신다. 네 상처는 고칠 수가 없다. \q 네가 입은 상처가 너무 깊다.
ko.R: {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 하시는 말씀이다. 네 상처는 나을 수 없다. \q 네 상처는 아주 심하다.

pt.L: Pois assim diz {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}}: Incurável [é] a tua fratura, \q grave a tua ferida.
pt.B: Pois assim diz {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}}: A tua lesão não tem cura; \q a tua ferida é grave.
pt.R: É isto que {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}} diz: A tua lesão não pode ser curada. \q A tua ferida é muito séria.

am.L: {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}} እንዲህ ይላልና፦ ስብራትሽ የማይፈወስ ነው፤ \q ቁስልሽም ክፉ ነው።
am.B: {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}} እንዲህ ይላልና፦ ጉዳትሽ ሊፈወስ አይችልም፤ \q ቁስልሽ ጽኑ ነው።
am.R: {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}} እንዲህ ይላል፦ ጉዳትሽ ሊድን አይችልም። \q ቁስልሽ እጅግ ከባድ ነው።

hi.L: क्योंकि {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} यों कहते हैं: तुम्हारी टूटन असाध्य [है], \q तुम्हारा घाव गहरा।
hi.B: क्योंकि {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} यह कहते हैं: तुम्हारी चोट ठीक नहीं हो सकती; \q तुम्हारा घाव गंभीर है।
hi.R: {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} यह कहते हैं: तुम्हारी चोट ठीक नहीं हो सकती। \q तुम्हारा घाव बहुत बुरा है।

ru.L: Ведь так говорит {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Яхве}}: Неисцелим твой перелом, \q тяжела твоя рана.
ru.B: Ведь так говорит {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Яхве}}: Твою рану не вылечить, \q твоё увечье тяжело.
ru.R: Вот что говорит {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Яхве}}: Твою рану не вылечить. \q Твоё увечье очень тяжёлое.

ja.L: まことに、{{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}はこう言われる。あなたの骨折は癒えず、 \q あなたの打ち傷は重い。
ja.B: {{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}はこう言われる。あなたの傷は治らず、 \q あなたの打ち傷は重い。
ja.R: {{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}はこう言われる。あなたのけがは治らない。 \q あなたの傷はとてもひどい。

uk.L: Бо так говорить {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Ягве}}: Невигойний твій перелом, \q тяжка твоя рана.
uk.B: Бо так говорить {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Ягве}}: Твоє каліцтво невиліковне, \q твоя рана тяжка.
uk.R: Так говорить {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Ягве}}: Твою рану неможливо вилікувати. \q Твоя рана дуже тяжка.

decisions.choice: your (spoken to a woman): Zion, the city and its people, pictured as a wounded woman
decisions.reason: From here to verse 17 the one spoken to is feminine, and verse 17 names her: Zion. The people called Jacob in verses 7-11 are now pictured as a woman broken by her wounds.

decisions.choice: incurable fracture: a break that no one can mend, the ruin of the nation
decisions.reason: The noun means a break or a shattering, used for the ruin of the people (8:21; 10:19; 14:17). "Incurable" is the word Jeremiah used of his own pain (15:18). By any human means the wound cannot be healed; verse 17 says who will heal it.

decisions.choice: injury ... severe (B); injury ... very bad (R)
decisions.reason: Literal keeps the picture of a broken bone, "fracture". Balanced and Readable say "injury", which covers the same hurt in plainer words, here and in verse 15.

decisions.choice: tu (Zion addressed as a woman)
